summary: Temporary access to investor data room for Q2 audit
description: Issue summary: The finance team requires temporary access for two external auditors to the investor data room and select Confluence pages for Q2 audit. Impact: Access is time-sensitive; delays may push audit milestones and delay investor reporting. Environment: internal - Confluence space: finance/investors, data room hosted via 3rd-party vendor VDRCo (vdrco.example.com). Steps to reproduce / request details: 1) Provision read-only access for external users auditors@auditfirm.com and audit2@auditfirm.com to the investor VDR for a 90-day window. 2) Create temporary Confluence guest accounts with view-only permission to finance/investors pages and the Q2 financials folder. 3) Ensure access is audited (who/when) and that KBA/2FA requirements are enforced per access policy. 4) Notify Legal and Security for approval and record the approval in linked Confluence page. Requested window: 2026-03-16 to 2026-06-16. Reviewer/approver: Legal (cc: legal-approvals@redwood.com). Additional notes: Vendor VDRCo requires a support ticket referencing Redwood internal request INT-4721; include point of contact Ethan Carter. If unable to grant guest Confluence accounts, please provide an alternative secure view link or set up a restricted PDF bundle with audit logs.
